_readme: Every reward, price and shop rule lives here. Edit numbers, save, reload the game. The game reads 'rewards', 'events' and 'shop'. All shop items below are PLACEHOLDER test data - names, prices and effects are just there so the shop has something to show (effects are not applied yet). See docs/ECONOMY.md for what every field means, and run 'py tools/economy_report.py' for a quick balance table.
_projectilesNote: Gameplay numbers for every projectile you can equip (the id must match a shop projectile / the PROJECTILES list). weight: NOT shown to the player - heavier projectiles fly lower with the same throw strength (100 = the reference snowball; a weight of 80 flies 25% higher). angleRange: how long the left-right offset bar is (1 = the full bar, 0.8 = a bar 20% shorter, so the throw can only drift 80% as far). angleSpeed: how fast the marker moves along the bar compared with normal (0.8 = 20% slower). coinMultiplier: multiplies the coins for a hit, rounded DOWN. leavesMark: false = no snow mark on the wall, it bounces off instead. spins: the projectile rotates in flight.

shop._priceOverrideNote: PLACEHOLDER: while priceOverride is a number, EVERY item costs that many coins in the shop (so we can test buying). Set it to null to use each item's real 'price' below.
shop._restockNote: After buying, that slot shows SOLD OUT for this many seconds (by the device clock, so it also counts while the app is closed), then restocks. 60 = 1 minute for testing; 3600 = 1 hour.

refill._categoryWeightsNote: Odds of each TYPE when a slot is (re)stocked: projectile 1 vs consumable 9 = a projectile shows up about 1 time in 10. Then an item of that type is picked at random.

shop._itemsNote: Empty slots show (TBD) - the shop only has real items now. Optional item field image = a picture path for the card. category is 'consumable' (common, can be bought again and again, and can be on sale in two slots at once; needs a duration) or 'projectile' (rare, bought once and kept, never on sale twice).
